  # Wallpaper — variety
  super + ctrl + space      variety --selector
  alt + n                   variety: next wallpaper
  alt + p                   variety: previous wallpaper
  alt + f                   variety: favourite wallpaper
  alt + t                   variety: trash wallpaper
  alt + Right               variety: next wallpaper
  alt + Left                variety: previous wallpaper
  alt + Up                  variety: toggle-pause
  alt + Down                variety: resume
  alt + shift + n           variety next + pywal recolor
  alt + shift + p           variety previous + pywal recolor
  alt + shift + f           variety favourite + pywal recolor
  alt + shift + t           variety trash + pywal recolor
  alt + shift + u           pywal: recolor from current wallpaper

── 2. Window Management ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + j                 focus next window
  super + k                 focus previous window
  super + shift + j         move window down the stack
  super + shift + k         move window up the stack
  super + ctrl+shift+Return promote window to master (zoom)
  super + f                 toggle fullscreen
  super + shift + space     toggle floating
  super + q                 close window
  super + shift + q         close window
  super + shift + c         close window
  super + i                 hide window        (also: +1 master count)
  super + shift + i         restore window     (also: +1 inner gap)
  super + shift + minus     decrease border width
  super + shift + p         increase border width
  super + shift + w         reset border width to default
  super + shift + Escape    xkill (click to kill)

── 3. Workspaces / Tags / Groups ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + 1..9              view tag 1–9            (AZERTY number row)
  super + shift + 1..9      send window to tag 1–9
  super + ctrl + 1..9       toggle-view tag 1–9
  super + ctrl + shift+1..9 toggle tag on window
  super + agrave            view all tags          (0 key)
  super + shift + agrave    send window to all tags
  super + Tab               view previously-selected tag
  super + Left              shift view to previous tag
  super + Right             shift view to next tag

── 4. Layout & Tiling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + space             toggle to default layout
  super + ctrl + p          previous layout (cycle)
  super + ctrl + m          next layout (cycle)
  super + ctrl + F1         set layout: tile
  super + ctrl + F2         set layout: spiral
  super + ctrl + F3         set layout: bstack
  super + ctrl + F4         set layout: bstackhoriz
  super + ctrl + F5         set layout: grid
  super + ctrl + F6         set layout: centeredmaster
  super + ctrl + F7..F12    set layout: tile
  super + ctrl + w          toggle tab mode
  super + i                 increase master count  (also: hide window)
  super + n                 decrease master count
  super + h                 shrink master area
  super + l                 grow master area
  super + shift + h         grow window size (cfact)
  super + shift + l         shrink window size (cfact)
  super + shift + o         reset window size (cfact)
  super + ctrl + t          toggle gaps
  super + ctrl + i          increase gaps
  super + ctrl + d          decrease gaps
  super + shift + i         increase inner gaps    (also: restore window)
  super + ctrl + shift + i  decrease inner gaps
  super + ctrl + o          increase outer gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + o  decrease outer gaps
  super + ctrl + section    increase inner horizontal gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + section   decrease inner horizontal gaps
  super + ctrl + egrave     increase inner vertical gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + egrave    decrease inner vertical gaps
  super + ctrl + exclam     increase outer horizontal gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + exclam    decrease outer horizontal gaps
  super + ctrl + ccedilla   increase outer vertical gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + ccedilla  decrease outer vertical gaps
  super + ctrl + shift + d  reset gaps to default

── 5. Multi-monitor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + comma             focus previous monitor
  super + semicolon         focus next monitor
  super + shift + Left      send window to previous monitor
  super + shift + Right     send window to next monitor

── 6. Multimedia & Hardware ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  XF86AudioRaiseVolume      amixer: volume +10%
  XF86AudioLowerVolume      amixer: volume -10%
  XF86AudioMute             amixer: toggle mute
  XF86AudioPlay             playerctl play-pause
  XF86AudioNext             playerctl next
  XF86AudioPrev             playerctl previous
  XF86AudioStop             playerctl stop
  XF86MonBrightnessUp       xbacklight +10
  XF86MonBrightnessDown     xbacklight -10

── 7. Screenshots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + u                 maim --select → clipboard (region)
  super + ctrl + u          maim → clipboard (fullscreen)
  Print                     scrot → Pictures (fullscreen)
  ctrl + Print              xfce4-screenshooter
  ctrl + shift + Print      gnome-screenshot -i
  ctrl + super + Print      flameshot gui

── 8. System & Session ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  super + b                 toggle bar
  super + g                 toggle compositor (fastcompmgr)
  super + x                 archlinux-logout
  ctrl + alt + k            archlinux-logout
  ctrl + alt + l            archlinux-logout
  super + shift + x         edu-powermenu
  super + shift + r         restart chadwm
  ctrl + alt + Delete       quit chadwm
  super + shift + s         reload sxhkd
  ctrl + alt + shift + F1   update-system
  super + ctrl + shift + F1 update-system
